title: My Cozy Train Game Week 1 Progress
author: Much-Method8139
selftext:
Hello, 

I have spent the last week making this cozy survival train game. So far this is just a graphical test to see if my assets and stuff look good so theres no true playable gameplay yet other than just basic movement.

 It is very rough currently but I think it has potential. I am curious to see if anyone of you would play a game like this. I am also looking for feedback, tips/tricks. Any questions about workflow is welcome. I am using godot for the engine.

 But yeah any feedback is apreciated. Many of the train layers need a redo and so do the mountains in the back not to mention the sky/lighting looks awful. 

But I will try to stick to this project for a while as I usually find myself starting too ambitious and then abandoning it. In will start with a small scope but maybe expand in the future if all goes well.

 I am also looking for ideas for the game (story/objectives/lore etc)! Anyways thanks for reading this!

comments.author: BearsDrinkVodka
comments.body: How did you make such animation what instrument did you use?

replies.author: Much-Method8139
replies.body: For animation I used a vid gen model and then sliced that into frames to make a sprite sheet. It is 2 directional.

comments.author: Leading_Patient9049
comments.body:
Oh that looks good already like fr looks so clean man.

A small recommendation would be that I would maybe make the character disappear when he goes through wagons, as if he goes through a tunnel to make the transition cleaner. 

If I may ask btw which model, reasoning, price model and tools do you use? Because I did a project in a week with the plus model and astra and well you can definitely see that it looks more like ai 😭 ( like wrong pixels, bad background etc etc)

replies.author: Much-Method8139
replies.body: Yeah I will def fix the phasing through the wagons lmao I just wanted to test how all the assets look put together. For coding I used opus 5.5 high with the godot mcp. For the assets I did a mix of z image in comfy ui and gpt image 2.5 flare. For the animations I used grok imagine 1.5 and the sliced it into frames. The assets def take human direction + a few attempts to get it to look decent. Hope this helps

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: Looks good so far. I had it on my list to make a train oriented game. Something about the vibes of train travel man is so alluring. In terms of feedback, it's still too early to say since clearly lots of stuff to fix but the overall style and presentation is nice. Also, are trains that short? I imagine trains give you more headroom... also some of the shadows on the assets make everything a bit too floaty when the object shouldn't cast such a big shadow. As for lore and objectives, well that's all up to you to riff on. It's gotta be your vision.

comments.author: avik_videogame
comments.body: It reminds me of a \*Starbound\* spaceship, only in the form of a train.

comments.author: pizzae
comments.body: Now we need bug blocks and peasants at the back of the train
